notes: Hindustan Times publishes only MONTH-NAMED sitemaps: robots.txt declares /sitemap/index.xml, whose 767 entries are /sitemap/<monthname>-<YYYY>.xml (back to june-2002) with a per-URL <lastmod> in IST (+05:30) - no daily sitemap of any form exists (2026-10-10.xml, 2026/10/10.xml, daily/, 20261010.xml, 10-october-2026.xml, news/2026-10-10.xml all 404) and there is no dated HTML archive. {MM} cannot spell a month name, so the window 2026-09-25..2026-10-25 needs the two literal files below (lastmod filter splits by day: 744 / 497 / 477 article URLs on 2026-09-30 / 10-10 / 10-20, whole day covered 00:03-23:40 IST); a different window means substituting that window's <monthname>-<YYYY>.xml files. robots.txt allows us; /sitemap/photos-*.xml and videos-*.xml are rolling (a few entries) so they add nothing. Verify with: printf '%%s' '{"list_templates":[...]}' > /tmp/x.json && python3 ./grids/recipes/check.py /tmp/x.json 0 hindustantimes-com
